title: Users
linkReady: Invitation link for {email} — valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, usable once. Pass it on yourself: it will not be shown again.
copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it.
confirmDelete: Delete the account {email}? Its connected mailboxes, emails and replies stored here will be erased. The mailbox itself is not touched.
newPasswordReady: The link for {email} to choose a new password is ready. Hand it to them: it is good once, for {minutes} minutes, and cannot be shown again.
confirmResetSecondFactor: Take the second factor of {email} away? They are signed out everywhere, and set a new one up at their next sign-in.
roleHint: An administrator manages the prompts, the invitations, the shared mailboxes and the organisation’s settings, and has no access to a member’s personal mailbox.
